description: Connector entry point (plx.find's home mode): one host capture cycle (as case.proactive_engine: the Portal sales orders into the source mirror, the PLXCUSTOMERS 'Customer Documents' folder through the GET-only Graph reader), the projection built and the scheduled proactive engine run once over it into the gap inbox, then offline an MCP session per reader over the stdio transport (operating.mcp_server.serve_stdio): initialize (the business primer), tools/list and tools/call plx.find with 'What needs my attention?', which answers with that reader's ranked inbox trimmed by its grant. Reports the gaps returned and cited, the top 3 (kind, priority, object type), the inbox state, rules not run and the seconds; counts and enums only, never an identifier or value. Repeated for a second reader with a narrower grant.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; the module test is injected-transport (operating/tests/test_connector_home.py LiveCheckTest: this spec's own command over the case.proactive_engine host config and world, an in-process FakeWorkbench and a fake drive, the network refused; expectations checked on the real summary; a Portal answering HTTP 500 at capture meets expect_blocked). It reuses the case.proactive_engine host config, mirror audience and live audience (read only). Green only with at least one returned, cited gap (json_min gaps_returned >= 1) and the inbox read, so a day with none is a truthful red, never a pass. The home mode reads the engine's persisted inbox; it never scans on the request, and the host stays at 22 tools.
